title: Record title-payload behavior across privileged finalizer retries

hosted_observation.quality_gate: failure at hosted PR landing finalizer step
hosted_observation.failure: The workflow event retained the PR title from the time the synchronize run was enqueued; it did not track later PR metadata edits. The guarded equality check correctly prevented finalizer execution.
hosted_observation.log_evidence: The finalizer step log exposed PR_TITLE and PR_HEAD_SHA and runs test "$PR_TITLE" = "$COMMIT_TITLE" before sudo invocation.

correction.next_verification: fresh pull_request synchronize event and full Required Quality Gate including hosted finalizer must pass before merge
correction.guard_changes: none; equality check, strict audit, test acceptance, and finalizer remain mandatory

outcome: the title comparison itself is functioning as designed; the failure came from immutable workflow event metadata. A corrected PR title is set before the next head update so the next synchronize event can bind matching values.
